items.prompt: Two distinct parallel 0--1 links each have weight 1, followed by 1--2 of weight 2. What line does node 2 print?

options.why: There are two link-distinct shortest routes, each with total distance 3.
Collapsing parallel edges loses a distinct link sequence.
That reports the number of links as latency instead of summing weights 1+2.
Parallel alternatives are choices, not links both traversed on one route.
